- The ball travels from (1.5, 1.5) toward P=(0,3), hitting the left cushion at 45°.
- Reflecting at 45°, it moves along direction (1,1): from (0,3) it reaches the top cushion at (3,6) (the orange point).
- Reflecting again at 45°, it moves along direction (1,−1): from (3,6) the path is (3+t, 6−t). At t=6 it reaches (9,0), which is exactly the corner pocket A.

So the ball drops into pocket A.
